Existential dispatch remains unqualified.

rows.label: guest supported
rows.scope: A fixed-arity builder uses buildEither and buildOptional to select one marker and up to three children from event bytes. Native Swift and installed Guest UI V1 on arm64 macOS emit identical frames, preserve the previous frame on a four-child event, and continue on the next valid event. The guest registry reclaims the closed session slot.

rows.label: guest supported
rows.scope: One value-type wrapper caps a stored UInt16 reading and projects a count of changes to the bounded value. Successive runtime events produce matching frames in native Swift and installed Guest UI v1 on arm64 macOS. Both paths refuse a reserved reading and preserve the previous frame. The owned VM rejects the stale handle after close.
Arbitrary compiler plugins and transitive generated dependencies remain unqualified.

The missing-plugin control diagnoses the call site before object emission.

A concrete typed error preserves the prior frame and its caught total appears in the next successful frame. Untyped throwing and guest Foundation remain unqualified.

rows.label: native supported
rows.scope: Exact emoji, Arabic and decomposed-accent bytes through native Codable. The macOS SDK guest event codec checks exact Unicode wire values and the SDK JSON guard rejects unpaired surrogates. This row covers native Codable and SDK wire validation.

rows.feature: Swift String — strict UTF-8 title preview
rows.label: guest supported
rows.scope: Embedded Swift 6.3.3 with the pinned stock WASI allocator decodes and trims ASCII edge whitespace from titles up to 32 bytes. Four title events preserve exact decomposed accent, Arabic, and emoji bytes and scalar counts in Guest UI V1 on arm64 macOS. Twelve refusals preserve the previous frame, and close reclaims the session slot. The separate Foundation arm fails to import Foundation.

rows.label: native supported
rows.scope: The native probe accepts nonblank titles and refuses a spaces-only title with its typed validation error. Other character sets and guest Foundation remain unqualified.

rows.label: guest supported
rows.scope: Installed Guest UI v1 on arm64 macOS matches native Swift for Float and Double addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, less-than, and equality to zero. Seven runtime inputs cover finite fractions, precision boundaries, subnormal products, and signed zero. The fixture refuses a truncated input without changing the result.

rows.label: native supported
rows.scope: Swift 6.3.3 on arm64 macOS reads back four exact timestamps, including pre-epoch and fractional values. The pinned Embedded Wasm target refuses the Foundation import before object emission.

rows.label: native supported
rows.scope: The FieldLog date style formats fixed timestamps under explicit English and French locales and UTC and UTC-08:00 on arm64 macOS. The pinned Embedded Wasm target refuses the Foundation import before object emission.

rows.label: native supported
rows.scope: FieldLog's exact workspace model matches titles and sites for six queries on arm64 macOS with Swift 6.3.3. The replay checks case, accents, Arabic, blank input, no match, and result order and stable project identity across workspace decoding. The Embedded target refuses the Foundation import before object emission.
Other locale selection and collation APIs need their own controls.

rows.scope: The macOS FeatureStore delivers the current replacement and suppresses results from three effects joined after replacement, explicit cancellation, or stop. Swift guest Task cancellation remains unqualified.

rows.label: native supported
rows.scope: An actor-isolated counter and awaited reads from @MainActor run on arm64 macOS. A synchronous nonisolated call is diagnosed. The pinned Embedded Swift 6.3.3 Wasm target refuses this fixture before object emission. Guest actor runtime behavior remains unqualified.

rows.label: native supported
rows.scope: A stored closure reads its capture across turns on arm64 macOS. Exact frames show object deinitialization on replacement and explicit release. Late invocation preserves the release frame. Embedded Swift emits objects for both variants; the import-free Wasm linker refuses unresolved posix_memalign and free. Guest execution remains unqualified.

rows.feature: Escaping closures — pinned stock WASI allocator
rows.label: guest supported
rows.scope: Object and direct-value captures match native frames in installed Guest UI V1 on arm64 macOS when linked with the pinned Swift 6.3.3 WASI libc.a. Both modules use zero imports and one fixed page. Late invocation preserves the release frame, and stale handles are refused after close.

rows.feature: Guest-local allocation — fixed-page exhaustion and reuse
rows.label: guest supported
rows.scope: The pinned Swift 6.3.3 WASI allocator runs through Guest UI V1 on arm64 macOS with zero imports, zero host calls, and one fixed 64 KiB page. Nine aligned 4,096-byte allocations succeed and the tenth returns ENOMEM. Freeing a middle block allows same-address reuse with intact canaries. A new session starts clean and the retired handle is refused.

rows.label: guest supported
rows.scope: The pinned WASI allocator grows from one to two pages on the tenth successful 4,096-byte allocation in Guest UI V1 on arm64 macOS. All nine pre-growth blocks retain their canaries. Attempt 26 returns ENOMEM at the two-page ceiling. The fixture then reuses the freed address and drains all blocks. Two fresh sessions match with zero host calls.

rows.feature: Host services through fixed capability imports
rows.label: host bridge required
rows.scope: The opt-in capability VM fixtures execute four typed enqueue routes. Unapproved import names and generic dispatch are refused. Each platform service needs its own approved adapter and behavioral qualification.
